messages.subject: Re: MaAsLin file format
messages.body_plain:
Hi Camille and Alessandro,

I have been able to use MaAsLin in Galaxy by allowing it to auto-detect the file format; if you then refresh the MaAsLin window (just click on it again in the menu on the left) it should detect your .pcl file.

Cheers,
Rachael
